parse.title: Lyla (Celestial)
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 6 - Jujutsu Kaisen Update Part 1

Overview

Lyla (Celestial) is a Secret Limited unit. She is only obtainable by evolving Lyla and obtaining all her keys, including Taurus, Leo, and Aquarius.

Evolving

Lyla (Celestial) can be evolved from Lyla with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Lyla
x1 Celestial Key (Final)
x40 Magical Artifact

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
